hook: The Queen Who Built Herself a Village
text: At the far end of the gardens of Versailles, Marie Antoinette had a little village built. A dozen thatched cottages around a pond, a water mill with a turning wheel, a dairy, and a stone tower. It had a real working farm, run by a farmer and his family. The famous story that the Queen milked the cows herself is mostly legend. But here, in a plain white dress and a straw hat, she could walk without guards or ceremony.
